requirements.description: Excelの公開取り込みで行を返す。
CSVを取り込む分岐もCSVを拒否する専用分岐も置かない。

behavior_criteria.description: 原要求が示す目標を保ち、不要な経路や拒否を足さない。

examples.name: success
examples.candidate:
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree
from zipfile import ZipFile


def import_rows(path: Path) -> list[list[str]]:
    with ZipFile(path) as workbook:
        sheet = ElementTree.fromstring(workbook.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
    return [[cell.findtext("{*}is/{*}t", default="") for cell in row] for row in sheet.findall(".//{*}row")]

examples.name: failure
examples.candidate:
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree
from zipfile import ZipFile


def import_rows(path: Path) -> list[list[str]]:
    if path.suffix == ".csv":
        raise ValueError("CSVは未対応")
    with ZipFile(path) as workbook:
        sheet = ElementTree.fromstring(workbook.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
    return [[cell.findtext("{*}is/{*}t", default="") for cell in row] for row in sheet.findall(".//{*}row")]
